input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including message. The platform provides capabilities for message, helloworld, guestbook. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to create and manage message records, so that I can track and organize message data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with helloworld ui functionality, so that I can accomplish my helloworld ui-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to use helloworld capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Candidate, I want to use guestbook capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
